exploration.title: Effect MCP 2026-07-28 Stateless Protocol Adoption
openQuestions: D-posture: keep G4 (2026-07-28 only everywhere), relax to a mixed list repo-wide, stage mixed then cut over per host, or a per-transport G4 exception? A mixed list mints a 2025 session even for clients offering 2026-07-28, so either way the proving host needs a client that never sends initialize.

D-run-key: what mints the GovernedTierGate run key over HTTP once initialize and mcp-session-id are gone (per-launch bearer, shell-minted run token, requestState with HMAC/AEAD, MRTR approval, or a stateful adapter on the sidecar only), owned in epistemic/server?
D-cli-contract: does G6 make vendor CLI opt-in flags operator notes only, or is a live first-message capture (Gate A 25) an entrance criterion before nlp-mcp flips?
D-client-home: where does the in-repo 2026 client (ClientRpcs with server/discover, header and _meta injection, stdio helper, SSE-aware decode) live, given Effect's 2026 client group is internal?
D-conformance: must a 2026-only host pass conformance --requirements 2026-07-28, and who owns the 404/-32601 waiver or the error-shape change?

D-projection: does api_key_required stay a non-error CallToolResult envelope and do invalid arguments stay a canned result or become InvalidParams, declared as error-translation at the kit protocol adapter?

D-origin: Origin allow-list home (OntologyMcpServerConfig, app literal with exception, or Effect allowedOrigins only), keep or drop the sidecar Origin middleware, OPTIONS 204 vs 403, Origin-less POST, and whether any browser-origin /mcp client is in scope?
